items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I followed Nat King Cole in there.

ctx.x: Call Cobbs you picked up here in New York?
Right. We went to the Plain and as I said, one of the finest jobs I ever had. That was the first of three times that I went in the Plain.
From the Plain we went into the Beachcomber in Omaha. I followed Nat King Cole in there. All these were high clubs.
